title: Coding-OS Adapter Manifest
description: Schema for adapters/<id>/adapter.yaml. Defines an agent adapter — its settings file, hooks directory, path-scoped rules support, and optional default settings deep-merged with aggregated hooks.

id.description: Must match the directory name under adapters/.

settings_file.description: Relative path inside the project where settings.json (or hooks.json) is written.

hooks_dir.description: Relative path inside the project for hook scripts. Null if the adapter has no hooks dir.

rules_dir.description: Relative path for path-scoped rule files. Null if the adapter doesn't support rules.

skills_dir.description: Relative path for skill files. Null if the adapter has no skill system.

commands_dir.description: Relative path for slash-command files (e.g. Claude's .claude/commands). Null for adapters that merge commands into a single instructions file.

sourced_hooks.description: Hook filenames that are sourced (not executed) — doctor skips their exec-bit check.

supports_rules.description: Whether the adapter honours path-scoped rules (YAML frontmatter globs).

supports_settings_json.description: Whether the adapter consumes a JSON settings file.

install_script.description: Relative filename of the adapter install script (usually install.sh).

cli_binary.description: Executable name discoverable on PATH for this agent (e.g. "claude"). Consumed by cli/doctor.py::_probe_claude_sdk so that file stays free of hardcoded adapter literals (rule #11). Optional — defaults to the adapter id when missing.

sdk_package.description: Importable Python package whose installed version doctor reports for this adapter (e.g. "claude-agent-sdk"). Empty string = no SDK to probe.

default_settings.description: Adapter-owned defaults deep-merged with aggregated world.hooks by render_settings_json().

hook_registry_output.description: Relative filename within adapters/<id>/ where cli/hook_renderer.py writes the rendered template (e.g. settings.template.json for claude, hooks.template.json for codex). Null if this adapter does not consume the hook registry.

runtime_env_markers.description: Environment variables whose presence identifies this adapter's runtime. Consumed by cli/board_commands.py::_detect_agent_runtime to attribute task_status_history.agent_session — avoids hardcoded adapter-name literals in CLI code (rule #11).

hook_capabilities.description: Which {event, matcher} pairs this adapter can actually trigger. Drives cli/hook_renderer.py when rendering adapter-specific settings from core/hooks/registry.yaml. Key = event name (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit).

matchers.description: Matcher strings this adapter can dispatch for the event. Empty-string matcher ('') means the event fires without a matcher (e.g. Stop).

cursor_native_hooks.description: Cursor-only native hook keys (camelCase, e.g. preCompact) merged into hooks.cursor.template.json after registry render.

script.description: Hook script basename under the adapter hooks dir (same as hook_dispatchers.script).

hook_dispatchers.description: Optional adapter-specific coalescing rules that replace multiple registry-derived hooks for one {event, matcher} pair with a single dispatcher script.

mcp_helper.description: Optional helper script (relative to adapters/<id>/) used by cli/main.py when wiring the MCP launch config for this agent. Absent means no helper is needed.

mcp_launch.description: Data-driven metadata for cli/doctor.py::_load_coding_os_mcp_launch. Lets the C15 check locate and parse the per-agent MCP config without hardcoded adapter-name literals.

loader.description: Which parser in cli/doctor.py handles this adapter's MCP config format.

presence.description: Optional Hub board + presence documentation. core/board_os/hub_adapter_manifest.py reads hub_glyph/hub_color; signal and presence_events are documentation for adapter-parity.

signal.description: Presence JSON under .coding-os/<adapter>/sessions/ is driven by agent-presence.sh on hook lifecycle events.

presence_events.description: Which events refresh presence for this adapter (documentation only).

hub_glyph.description: Short badge text in Hub Scrumban live-agents strip.

hub_color.description: Badge accent color (hex) for Hub UI.
